counter_semantics: excluded_loop_write / excluded_nested_write count LOCALS whose writes are all simple-assignment statements and at least one is loop- / block-nested; a local with a disqualifying write (compound, write inside an expression, deconstruction, ++/--, ref/out, lambda) is excluded silently in every build, so these counters are lower bounds (lab/h23/cnt/results.json); write_* counters are per WRITE on the locals the seam versions
